description: Task-based discovery of component APIs, usage guidance, examples and token references.
limitations: Own component props are included. Inherited React and native HTML props remain available through the published TypeScript declarations and full API documentation.
TypeScript types and defaults are source text, not JSON validation rules. Conditional prop requirements need the published declarations and authored guidance.
Keyboard keys and ARIA names are source facts, not proof that every interaction or accessibility requirement has been verified.
Runtime verification and design parity are not included in these contracts. Story links identify examples, not test results.

styled.guidance: Styled components use the optional shared stylesheet. Import it once to use the supplied visual language; omitting it requires consumer styling.

headless.guidance: This entry re-exports Base UI primitives without CSS. Its APIs are Base UI APIs, distinct from the styled component contracts in this index.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: A native button for an action, with independent size, intent, emphasis, and loading state.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.purpose: A visual and semantic group of related buttons without adding selection behavior.

components.name: CopyButton
components.purpose: An explicit clipboard action with a temporary success icon and optional notification.

components.name: IconButton
components.purpose: A compact Button with a required accessible label and an optional label tooltip.

components.name: Link
components.purpose: A native anchor for navigation, with optional icons and explicit external-link behavior.

components.name: SplitButton
components.purpose: A frequent primary action paired with a menu of related alternatives.

components.name: AiCard
components.purpose: A labeled AI-generated result with optional confidence, provenance, feedback, and regeneration.

components.name: AiHighlight
components.purpose: A compact complementary AI result with optional confidence and provenance.

components.name: AiInlineSuggestion
components.purpose: An input or textarea with an optional proposed suffix that the user explicitly accepts or dismisses.

components.name: AiMessage
components.purpose: A user or assistant conversation entry with source context, progress, citations, and optional result actions.

components.name: ConfidenceBadge
components.purpose: A textual high, medium, or low confidence indicator with a supplementary bar motif.

components.name: StreamingSkeleton
components.purpose: A named placeholder for an AI response that has not yet produced readable content.

components.name: ThinkingIndicator
components.purpose: An AI working status with optional rotating messages and a compact presentation.

components.name: Area chart
components.purpose: An ordered series chart that emphasizes magnitude with a filled area beneath the line.

components.name: Bar chart
components.purpose: A categorical or interval comparison with grouped or stacked bars and active-bar feedback.

components.name: Chart container
components.purpose: A named chart figure that coordinates the title, description, plot area, loading, error, legend, and footer.

components.name: Chart metric card
components.purpose: A summary metric, explicit comparison, latest readout, and underlying bar, area, or compact-bar series.

components.name: Donut chart
components.purpose: A part-to-whole summary with a visible total, category legend, and optional exact data table.

components.name: Event histogram
components.purpose: Stacked severity counts over time, composed from BarChart and a shared TimeRange value.

components.name: GanttChart
components.purpose: A schedule view of tasks, milestones, progress, and dependencies across a day, week, or month scale.

components.name: Line chart
components.purpose: An ordered series chart for comparing change over time without filling the area below each line.

components.name: Metric card
components.purpose: A summary value with an optional unit, percentage comparison, and compact supporting trend.

components.name: Mini bar chart
components.purpose: The compact zero-based bar form of Sparkline for non-negative interval values.

components.name: Sparkline
components.purpose: A lightweight SVG trend designed for compact summaries without animation or interactive focus.

components.name: CodeEditor
components.purpose: A token-themed CodeMirror editor with controlled text, folding, line numbers, and bounded height.

components.name: DiffView
components.purpose: A split or unified source comparison with exact change counts and change navigation.

components.name: YamlPresenter
components.purpose: A readonly YAML source panel with filename, copy, fold, and unfold controls.

components.name: ExpandableText
components.purpose: A plain-text preview that exposes a disclosure control only when its line limit is exceeded.

components.name: DataGrid
components.purpose: A typed record grid with sorting, selection, column controls, expansion, grouping, pagination, and virtualization.

components.name: DescriptionList
components.purpose: A semantic set of labels and values for inspecting record or configuration details.

components.name: FilePreview
components.purpose: Show file metadata with a raster image lightbox or a safe document fallback and optional download link.

components.name: Actions cell
components.purpose: A row-action group with a limited number of visible icon buttons and an overflow menu.

components.name: AI verdict cell
components.purpose: A compact AI suggestion with a normalized confidence score and an explicit review reminder.

components.name: Bulk actions bar
components.purpose: Controlled batch actions for the current selected record set, with asynchronous operation feedback.

components.name: Cells
components.purpose: A compact user, project, or account identity with a primary name and optional supporting detail.

components.name: Expand cell
components.purpose: A row disclosure button with optional nested-item count.

components.name: Number cell
components.purpose: A consistently formatted numeric table value using Intl.NumberFormat.

components.name: Severity cell
components.purpose: A table adapter to the shared SeverityBadge scale.

components.name: Sparkline cell
components.purpose: A lightweight, noninteractive trend graphic inside a dense table cell.

components.name: Status cell
components.purpose: A data-grid adapter to the standard record lifecycle badge.

components.name: Tags cell
components.purpose: A bounded row of static tags with a named overflow summary.

components.name: Time cell
components.purpose: The compact RelativeTime presentation for a data-grid timestamp.

components.name: Indicator
components.purpose: Position a named notification dot or count around existing content while preserving child interaction.

components.name: JsonViewer
components.purpose: A bounded, expandable JSON tree with type-aware values and path or value copying.

components.name: RelativeTime
components.purpose: A relative timestamp with an absolute date and timezone available on focus and hover.

components.name: SortableList
components.purpose: Reorder a controlled vertical list using pointer dragging, keyboard dragging or explicit move actions.

components.name: Timeline
components.purpose: An ordered activity list with timestamps, event types, optional actors, and actions.

components.name: Empty state
components.purpose: A named explanation of no results, no data, or a loading failure, with optional recovery actions.

components.name: Notification
components.purpose: One notification presentation for inline messages and floating lifecycle-managed feedback.

components.name: Progress bar
components.purpose: Determinate or indeterminate progress with a required accessible task label.

components.name: Skeleton
components.purpose: A decorative placeholder that reserves the approximate shape of pending content.

components.name: Spinner
components.purpose: A small activity indicator that can be either decorative or a named loading status.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: An independent boolean or mixed selection control with an optional label and description.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.purpose: Choose a hexadecimal RGB color, optionally with alpha, using editable text, named swatches and a native RGB picker.

components.name: Combobox
components.purpose: Search and choose one stable option ID while preserving independent query and selected value state.

components.name: CopyableField
components.purpose: A readonly, selectable value paired with a clearly labeled copy action.

components.name: DatePicker
components.purpose: A single-date calendar inside a focus-managed popover.

components.name: DateTimePicker
components.purpose: Edit a local date/time string with an explicit displayed interpretation zone while leaving instant resolution to the host.

components.name: Field
components.purpose: A label, helper text, and validation boundary that shares accessible metadata with one compatible control.

components.name: FileUpload
components.purpose: A file-selection and upload list with validation, progress, cancellation, and retry.

components.name: InlineEdit
components.purpose: Edit a single committed text value through an explicit local draft, validation, save and cancel lifecycle.

components.name: MultiCombobox
components.purpose: A searchable multiple-choice picker with removable chips and explicit selection controls.

components.name: NumberInput
components.purpose: Nullable numeric entry with locale-aware display, native form participation and optional shared step buttons.

components.name: OtpInput
components.purpose: Edit a bounded complete one-time code in one native input with paste, autocomplete and native form participation.

components.name: PasswordInput
components.purpose: A native password field with a named reveal/conceal action, composed from TextInput and IconButton.

components.name: PhoneInput
components.purpose: Edit raw telephone text with explicit country context and separate metadata-backed formatting/parse candidates.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.purpose: A labeled set of mutually exclusive options with optional per-option descriptions.

components.name: RichTextEditor
components.purpose: Edit schema-based rich text with bold, italic, lists, links and undo/redo using a mature text editing engine.

components.name: SearchInput
components.purpose: A searchable text field that separates immediate draft changes from debounced search requests.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.purpose: A compact, mutually exclusive choice implemented with native radio inputs.

components.name: Select
components.purpose: A single-value picker with grouped options, optional icons, descriptions, and native form integration.

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: One or more keyboard-operable thumbs for a numeric value or bounded range.

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: A binary on/off control for a setting, with a label that remains stable across states.

components.name: Textarea
components.purpose: A multiline native text control with optional measured growth and a character count.

components.name: TextInput
components.purpose: A single-line native input with optional prefix, suffix, clear control, and Field integration.

components.name: TimePicker
components.purpose: Enter a standalone local time through the native browser time input without attaching a date or time zone.

components.name: TimeRangePicker
components.purpose: A period selector that commits a relative preset or a validated absolute UTC interval.

components.name: TreeView
components.purpose: A hierarchical multi-selection tree whose branch check states are derived from selectable leaves.

components.name: ResizablePanels
components.purpose: Composable split panes backed by react-resizable-panels, with labeled resize handles.

components.name: Accordion
components.purpose: A set of labeled disclosure rows for content that can be explored independently.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.purpose: A menu attached to a content region, opened through a context gesture or keyboard command.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.purpose: A compact menu of actions, checkbox choices, radio choices, groups, and nested menus.

components.name: List
components.purpose: A native list with one-line or two-line rows, optional selection controls, identity, tags, counters, and nested groups.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.purpose: A navigation trail ending in a noninteractive current-page label.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.purpose: A searchable modal command list with grouped actions and optional global shortcut registration.

components.name: Pagination
components.purpose: Controlled navigation through result pages, with an optional page-size selector.

components.name: SideNav
components.purpose: A collapsible application navigation rail with groups, counts, search, workspace content, and a footer.

components.name: Stepper
components.purpose: An ordered progress indicator that can allow return navigation to completed steps.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: A labeled set of peer views using Base UI tabs and associated content panels.

components.name: BottomSheet
components.purpose: A bottom-only nonmodal panel for an existing bounded flex-column workspace.

components.name: Modal
components.purpose: A blocking dialog for a focused task, with a required title and independently scrollable content.

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: Anchored interactive content with optional header and footer outside the scrollable body.

components.name: Sheet
components.purpose: A nonmodal, resizable panel that pushes content within its own bounded workspace.

components.name: SideSheet
components.purpose: A right-side detail panel that can be modal or docked beside the workspace.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Brief supplementary information associated with a hoverable and keyboard-focusable trigger.

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: A person or entity image with initials fallback and optional presence status.

components.name: PresenceIndicator
components.purpose: Display host-provided online, away, busy or offline availability with explicit accessible meaning.

components.name: Card
components.purpose: A composable section surface with header, title, description, content, and footer slots.

components.name: Separator
components.purpose: A horizontal or vertical divider for a meaningful boundary between adjacent content.

components.name: CountBadge
components.purpose: A compact count that can visually cap large values while preserving their full meaning.

components.name: Kbd
components.purpose: A visual keyboard-key label with native kbd semantics.

components.name: SeverityBadge
components.purpose: A severity label using the shared critical, high, medium, low, and info scale.

components.name: StatusBadge
components.purpose: A textual lifecycle status for new, in-review, in-progress, completed, or cancelled records.

components.name: Tag
components.purpose: A compact label with distinct static, removable, interactive, counter, and status behaviors.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.purpose: A named, keyboard-focusable native scrolling region with a configurable maximum height.

components.name: Iconography
components.purpose: A shared named icon adapter for consistent stroke-based interface artwork.

components.name: AiDiffReview
components.purpose: An explicit approve or reject boundary around an AI-proposed document change.

components.name: AiPanel
components.purpose: A docked or overlay assistant workspace with a conversation, context-aware composer, and cancellable streaming.

components.name: PromptInput
components.purpose: An AI message composer with removable context, slash commands, and send or stop controls.

components.name: AppShell
components.purpose: An application shell with persistent page content, accessible landmarks and a shared mobile navigation sheet.

components.name: CollectionToolbar
components.purpose: Compose generic controlled collection search, host filter/action slots and a result status without assuming a record model.

components.name: FilterBar
components.purpose: A controlled search and table toolbar with mutually exclusive inline or sidebar filter editing.

components.name: FilterPanel
components.purpose: A record-filter sidebar with searchable checkbox facets, contextual counts, and collapsible groups.

components.name: FormErrorSummary
components.purpose: A linked, focusable form error summary. It accepts validation results rather than deciding form validity.

components.name: FormSection
components.purpose: Group related labeled form controls in a native fieldset with an associated description and responsive field layout.

components.name: NotificationCenter
components.purpose: A right-side notification panel with search, all/unread views, read state, and optional item actions.

components.name: OnboardingChecklist
components.purpose: A host-controlled setup checklist with measurable progress and optional actions per step.

components.name: PageHeader
components.purpose: A consistent page title hierarchy with optional back navigation, breadcrumbs, metadata, actions, and secondary content.

components.name: PageLayout
components.purpose: Initial library choices for collection, detail, settings, and dashboard pages. PageHeader owns the heading and actions. PageLayout adds transparent region wrappers without page padding or child styling. ReadingColumn provides 55ch/65ch/75ch starting measures. ContentGrid uses a container-responsive maximum of one to four columns. Products can propose additional recipes through review.

components.name: RecordEditor
components.purpose: A generic view/edit/save/cancel/delete workflow with explicit record versions and retained failure drafts.

components.name: ResourceState
components.purpose: A common boundary for loading, retained refresh, stale results, error and empty presentation.

components.name: UnsavedChangesBar
components.purpose: An inline save/discard boundary for host-owned edited data.

components.name: UnsavedNavigationGuard
components.purpose: A router-neutral adapter for explicitly guarded navigation and a best-effort unload warning.
